title: Safe JSON Parse
prompt: Write `safeParse(json, fallback)` that RETURNS the parsed value when `json` is valid JSON, and RETURNS `fallback` when it is not. It must never throw, whatever the input.

tests.name: parses valid JSON
tests.hint: JSON.parse handles objects, arrays, numbers, and strings — just wrap the call.

tests.name: returns the fallback for invalid JSON
tests.hint: try { return JSON.parse(json); } catch { return fallback; }

tests.name: never throws, whatever the input
tests.hint: The catch block catches JSON.parse's TypeError for non-string inputs too — no extra checks needed.
